sources.title: Visual and Cognitive Demands of Using In-Vehicle Information Systems
sources.publisher: AAA Foundation for Traffic Safety; University of Utah research
sources.method: 120 licensed drivers21-36;30 model-year2017 cars;24 drivers per vehicle, many drove several cars;2-mile low-traffic residential road25mph;phone/text/radio/navigation tasks.
sources.verified_claim: 23/30 vehicles generated high or very high overall demand in selected tasks;7 moderate;voice lower visual demand but longer interaction.
sources.limits: Historic cars, young drivers, selected tasks and supervised setting;not our fan/media correction latency,2026 Tesla performance,daily pain frequency or intervention benefit.

sources.title: In-Vehicle Infotainment Systems Especially Distracting to Older Drivers
sources.method: 128 participants in ages21-36 and55-75;six2018 cars;voice,touchscreen and other controls;calling,text,radio,navigation tasks.
sources.limits: Historical specific tasks,not our baseline or measured improvement;sample results do not generalize all older people.
sources.status: Reopened data table and sample summary 2026-10-17

sources.title: How Users React to Proactive Voice Assistant Behavior While Driving
sources.authors: Maria Schmidt, Wolfgang Minker, Steffen Werner
sources.method: 42 participants;Wizard-of-Oz driving simulator;traffic-density variation;six in-car use cases;proactive and non-proactive conditions;questionnaires and reactions.
sources.verified_claim: 73.8% proactive suggestion acceptance;82.5% driving-related use cases;proactive and non-proactive rated similarly positive.
sources.limits: Counterevidence against always-quiet assumption;small simulator study,not naturalistic driving or this product efficacy.

sources.title: Model Y Owner's Manual: Media / Grok (Beta)
sources.verified_claim: Grok needs Premium Connectivity orWi-Fi;Assistant personality supports navigation,phone,media,controls search and common vehicle controls such as climate;existing voice commands remain.
sources.limits: Depends on configuration,region and software;US manual not proof on user's car. No inference that undocumented C recovery/capability negotiation is absent.

sources.title: Model Y Owner's Manual: Touchscreen / Rear Touchscreen
sources.verified_claim: Rear fan/media/volume;rear media+volume affect front cabin;front rear-display remote+lock;Joe Mode reduces noncritical chimes.
sources.limits: No universal rear-song-selection claim;configuration/region/software differences. No hands-on superiority test.
sources.status: Reopened live manual including rear screen andJoeMode 2026-10-17
